testCase:
R-40: Get owner-financing homesite land for sale in New Mexico, Luna County, listed in the last 30 days, and contact the cheapest per acre land seller.
Goal: Get owner-financing homesite land for sale in New Mexico, Luna County, listed in the last 30 days, and contact the cheapest per acre land seller.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-40/
STEP 2: Hover over "Land for sale"
STEP 3: Click "New Mexico"
STEP 4: Click "Luna County"
STEP 5: Select "Homesite" in "Property type"
STEP 6: Check "Owner financing"
STEP 7: Select "Last 30 days" in "Listed"
STEP 8: Select "Price per acre: low to high" in "Sort"
STEP 9: Click "View listing" of the first property
STEP 10: Verify "Not sent: the seller form" is visible

plan.title: R-40: Cheapest qualifying Luna County homesite

args.label: Sort
args.option: Price per acre: low to high

steps.note: Place the cheapest per-acre property first.
Open the first matching View listing control in the sorted results.
Verify the exact seller-form status requested by the case.

reasoning: This tests filtering Luna County homesites by owner financing and recent listing date, then opening the cheapest result per acre. The plan follows the specified controls and verifies the requested seller-form status without claiming a message was sent.
